name: reflect
description: When you correct Claude, offers to save the fix as a lasting rule: in your global CLAUDE.md, in the project's CLAUDE.md, or as a note in a rules folder. Nothing is written until you press a button, you see the exact text first, and every save can be undone.

rules_folder.title: Rules folder
rules_folder.description: The folder where Save to vault writes rule notes, for example ~/Documents/rules. Leave empty to be asked once and have the answer remembered.

project_scope.title: Offer Save to project
project_scope.description: Show a Save to project button that adds the rule to the CLAUDE.md of the folder this chat runs in.

sensitivity.title: How eagerly to offer
sensitivity.description: careful: only clear corrections (No, I said..., never do X, from now on). normal: clear ones, plus doubtful ones a quick check confirms. eager: also check weak hints.

cooldown_minutes.title: Quiet time between offers (minutes)
cooldown_minutes.description: After an offer is shown, no new one for this long. It doubles for each offer in a row you skip. 0 turns the quiet time off.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model alias used to draft the rule, for example sonnet or haiku.

plain_dashes.title: Plain dashes
plain_dashes.description: Replace long dashes with commas in the drafted rule.
